territories.name: Senegal
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Senegal levies a value added tax of its own under its Code général des impôts (loi n° 2012-31 du 31 décembre 2012), whose article 369 sets its rates, harmonised within the West African Economic and Monetary Union by Directive n° 02/98/CM/UEMOA as amended by Directive n° 02/2009/CM/UEMOA.
